thread:
nisha: Alert — several eu-west-1 nodes failing to decrypt keystore on join; GPU onboards stuck. log: "keystore: decrypt failed: expired session token" :frowning:
opsbot: Incident created KEYS-INC-4521 and runbook link https://redwood.incidents/4521
alex.k: Do we know if this is KMS throttling or IAM session TTL expiring? Any recent firewall changes?
maria: We rolled the privatelink firewall tightening at 08:12. Keystore now does an STS assume with sessionDuration=300s. Node join often takes 4–6m under contention.
tj: That 300s session is too short given our warm-pool handshake + cert bootstrap. Quick mitigation: temporarily open egress 443 from warm-pool subnets to keystore to speed handshake.
nisha: Security prefers not to open broadly. Alternative: bump session TTL for join flow to 20m (1200s) but that increases audit writes and surface area.
sean: If we bump TTL, audit log volume and S3 PUTs will spike. Also KMS decrypt ops may rise. Cost estimate? rough calc: +30k requests/day -> ~$120/day. Worth it to keep onboarding rolling?
alex.k: We can also enable ephemeral KV-cache in the serving runtime for warm-pool nodes: cache decrypted key for 15m so repeat decrypts are avoided. Less audit churn.
maria: Proposed plan:
 1) canary rollback firewall rule for warm-pool subnet (tj)
 2) patch keystore to issue join tokens with sessionDuration=1200s (alex.k)
 3) enable runtime ephemeral cache for warm-pool canary (sean)
 4) monitor audit logs and KMS metrics for 2 hours, then evaluate (nisha)
Who can own 2 and 3?
tj: I'll take 1 now.
alex.k: I'll open PR for keystore change and add feature flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood/keystore/pull/1234
sean: I'll flip the runtime flag in staging and run load test; will post results here.
nisha: Also add a timeboxed security exception and update runbook. we should log the decision and attach a follow-up postmortem. @opsbot create ticket KEYS-9876 for TTL rollout and PMO-3456 for postmortem.
opsbot: Created tickets KEYS-9876, PMO-3456 :white_check_mark:
maria: Good. If canary looks good, we schedule full rollout with rollback knob. Keep audit-retention team in the loop — they may need to increase ingestion throughput.
sean: FYI snippet for IAM role change I'll include in PR:
  AssumeRolePolicyDocument: { "Version":"2012-10-17", "Statement":[{"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"ec2.amazonaws.com"}}]},
  MaxSessionDuration: 1200
alex.k: Cool. I'll add metrics: keystore_decrypt_lat, keystore_decrypt_errors, kinesis_audit_puts. Alert if decrypt_errors > 1% for 10m.
nisha: Thanks team. Let's sync in 30m. :eyes:
